messages:
Carmen: FYI vendor PolarisCompute sent INV-PC-309 for $36,720. PDF attached but no PO reference and they charged 20% VAT even though contract says zero-rated export. Can AP hold? @Liam @Procurement

ap-bot: invoice INV-PC-309 uploaded: invoices/2026/Polaris_INV-PC-309.pdf (size: 298KB). auto-pay: true

Liam: AP 1: please hold payment. We need PO match OR tax-corrected invoice. Also need GL code and entity (US vs EU).

Procurement: Searching 1: found PO PC-7612 for PolarisCompute, amount €28,000 (approved by Nadia). PO shows EUR whereas vendor invoiced in USD and didn't reference PC-7612.

Nadia: Confirm PO PC-7612 exists. This was for dedicated inference capacity. Procurement updated PO metadata to note expected currency EUR. Vendor should have invoiced against PO in EUR and referenced the PO number.

FinanceOps: VAT concern 1: vendor charged 20% VAT (line: VAT 20% = $6,120). Our contract (section 9) indicates export sales to US entity are VAT-exempt; vendor must issue corrected invoice without VAT or provide VAT ID documentation.

Liam: Marking AP hold: HOLD_TAX_PO. Ticket AP-6543 created to block payment cycle and flag tax dispute.

Carmen: Message sent to billing@polariscompute.eu: "Please reissue invoice INV-PC-309 referencing PO PC-7612, invoice in EUR (or show conversion), and remove VAT per contract export clause OR provide VAT registration proof. Cannot process until corrected."

Polaris-billing: (automated reply) Thank you we received your request. We'll review and reissue corrected invoice within 2 business days. Contact: accounts@polariscompute.eu

Procurement: If they reissue in EUR for €28,000 we'll pay the PO-backed amount immediately once AP receives corrected PDF. Any FX delta needs backup.

FinanceOps: If vendor insists USD, we need the conversion rate used and reconciliation to PO EUR value. Also need confirmation of tax status.

Nadia: If vendor refuses correction, escalate to Legal. But first let's wait 48 hours for corrected invoice.

Liam: AP set reminder 48h on AP-6543. Leaving reaction :hourglass_flowing_sand:. Invoice on hold until vendor provides corrected invoice or VAT docs.

Carmen: I'll update thread when vendor responds. Attaching snapshot from PDF header for quick ref:
```
Invoice: INV-PC-309
Date: 2026-04-02
Amount: $36,720.00
VAT: $6,120 (20%)
PO: (none)
```

Procurement: Thanks I'll link PO PC-7612 to AP ticket AP-6543 and prep conversion note in case vendor reissues USD.

Liam: Perfect. For now AP holds payment and flags tax dispute. :white_check_mark:
